title: 第5章 竟活了万年之久第6章 终于可以修炼了
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第5章竟活了万年之久？数百年的话，柳梦妍感觉还算是能够招架一番。
可万年之久，这是一个什么概念？
大周国都没有那么长时间的历史，大周国成立也不过才近千年罢了。
万年……这不成了老不死的老怪物了？
这是柳家能够对抗的吗？就算是大周皇室，恐怕也不敢造次吧？
柳梦妍两人不敢想，也想象不到，如今的陈长安，究竟实力达到了什么地步。
这毕竟是他们不曾触摸，甚至是听都没有听到过的层面。
“都起来吧。”
“真是没想到，陈家如今，竟然也已经沦落到了这番田地。”
听到陈长安的话，陈家众人都感觉有些羞愧。
陈长安向着柳梦妍两个人看了过去，见两人此时面对自己十分的紧张，不由得微微一笑。
“放心，我不杀你们。”
“至于这份契约……你们今天是带不走了。”
“等着吧，过段时间，我们陈家人，会亲自登门拜访，亲自给你们送去！”
“滚吧！”
陈长安毫无修为，但样子摆的十足，让柳梦妍两人此时都是心惊胆战。
不敢有片刻的犹豫，对着陈长安鞠了一躬，随后两人便匆忙的离开了陈家。
“你小子刚才表现不错。”
“勇气可嘉，但你就不怕，没有实力的硬气，会有性命之危吗？”
这句话，陈长安是对着陈云轩说的。
陈云轩没想到老祖居然会夸奖自己，心中也是充满了激动。
“回老祖的话，我赌柳家的人，不会灭了陈家。”
“哦？为何？”
“柳家如今乃是大周国的三大家族之一，自然是极好面子。”
“陈家和柳家之间的关系，还是有不少人知道的。”
“柳家可以当从不认识陈家，但他们不会对陈家出手。”
“不然的话，他们柳家就会背上一个落井下石，背信弃义的骂名。”
“灭掉陈家，对他们没有任何的意义，最多……杀了我一个人而已。”陈云轩笑着说道。
见陈云轩并不是逞一时口舌之快，陈长安满意的点了点头。
“你不怕死？”
“但我可以死，陈家不可辱！”陈云轩斩钉截铁的说道。
陈云轩的话，让陈家众人都是一脸欣慰，对于他这位少主，更是十分满意。
content_en:
Chapter 5: Lived for ten thousand years? After hundreds of years, Liu Mengyan felt that she could still resist.
But for thousands of years, what kind of concept is this?
The Great Zhou Kingdom does not have such a long history, and the Great Zhou Kingdom was only established for nearly a thousand years.
Ten thousand years...hasn't this become an immortal old monster?
Is this something the Liu family can resist? Even the royal family of the Great Zhou Dynasty would not dare to make a mistake, right?
Liu Mengyan and the others dare not think about it, nor can they imagine what level of strength Chen Changan has reached now.
After all, this is a level they have never touched or even heard.
"Everyone, get up."
"I really didn't expect that the Chen family has fallen into this situation."
After hearing Chen Changan's words, everyone in the Chen family felt a little ashamed.
Chen Changan looked at Liu Mengyan and the two of them, and couldn't help but smile when he saw that the two of them were very nervous when facing him.
"Don't worry, I won't kill you."
"As for this contract... you can't take it away today."
"Just wait. After a while, our Chen family will visit you personally and deliver it to you personally!"
"Go away!"
Chen Changan had no cultivation skills, but his appearance was so good that both Liu Mengyan and Liu Mengyan were frightened at this moment.
Not daring to hesitate for a moment, he bowed to Chen Changan, and then the two of them left the Chen family in a hurry.
"You did a good job just now."
"Courage is commendable, but aren't you afraid? Without strength, will your life be in danger?"
Chen Changan said this to Chen Yunxuan.
Chen Yunxuan did not expect that his ancestor would praise him, and his heart was filled with excitement.
"If I go back to my ancestors, I bet that the Liu family will not destroy the Chen family."
"Oh? Why?"
"The Liu family is now one of the three major families in the Great Zhou Kingdom, so naturally it has great reputation."
"Many people still know about the relationship between the Chen family and the Liu family."
"The Liu family can pretend they have never known the Chen family, but they will not take action against the Chen family."
"Otherwise, the Liu family will be blamed for adding insult to injury and being treacherous."
"Destroying the Chen family has no meaning to them. At most...it will just kill me." Chen Yunxuan said with a smile.
Seeing that Chen Yunxuan was not just showing off his quick words, Chen Changan nodded with satisfaction.
"Aren't you afraid of death?"
"Afraid!"
"But I can die, but the Chen family cannot be humiliated!" Chen Yunxuan said firmly.
Chen Yunxuan's words made everyone in the Chen family look happy, and they were very satisfied with his young master.
